title: XFA Visual Evidence Result
description: Output schema for scripts/xfa_visual_evidence.py. Zero paid API calls — existing oracle artifacts only.

doc_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the input PDF document.

doc_filename.description: Basename of the input PDF document.

oracle_path.description: Filesystem path to the oracle PNG or PDF used for comparison.

dry_run.description: Whether this result was produced in dry-run mode (no outputs written).

oracle_coverage_gap.description: Set to true when no oracle artifact exists for this doc. SSIM scores are absent.

gap_reason.description: Human-readable explanation of oracle coverage gap (if oracle_coverage_gap is true).

per_page.description: Per-page SSIM scores and output image paths.

ssim.description: SSIM score for this page in range [0, 1]. Higher is more similar.

ours.description: Path to PNG of our rendered page.

oracle.description: Path to PNG of oracle rendered page.

aggregate.description: Aggregate statistics across all compared pages.

mean_ssim.description: Mean SSIM across all pages. Null in dry-run or gap mode.

min_ssim.description: Minimum SSIM across all pages. Null in dry-run or gap mode.

max_ssim.description: Maximum SSIM across all pages. Null in dry-run or gap mode.

page_count.description: Number of pages compared (0 in dry-run or gap mode).
